blocks.text: Most car detailing in Cleveland runs between $80 and $600 depending on what you're getting: quick express details sit around $40–$100, interior-only details typically land between $190 and $300, and a full interior-plus-exterior detail on a sedan usually costs $250–$450. Those ranges were compiled in July 2026 from published Cleveland-area shop pricing, including Diamond Finish, Nathan's, GK's Custom, Clean Concepts, and Panda Hub.
Cleveland detailing prices by service type

items: Full detail (interior + exterior): roughly $250–$450 for most sedans.
Premium and coating packages: $450–$600 and up.
Vehicle size — most Cleveland shops tier pricing from coupes up to full-size SUVs and trucks, with larger vehicle classes priced higher.
Condition — heavy soiling and pet hair commonly add a surcharge at local shops.
Mobile vs. shop — mobile detailers come to your driveway; some price that convenience in, others charge the same as a shop visit.

blocks.text: What an interior detail costs on the east side

Fresh Mobile Detailing is an interior-first mobile service based in the Beachwood / Mayfield Heights area. A Full Interior Detail is $209 and takes about 2 hours. The Ultimate Interior Detail is $279 and takes about 3 hours. Membership visits bring the per-visit price down: $149 monthly, $169 bi-monthly, or $189 quarterly, and booking alongside a neighbor takes $25 off. Every job carries the Door-Open Guarantee: wow when you open the door, or you don't pay.
Is mobile detailing worth it in Cleveland?

If you're east of the city — Beachwood, Solon, Orange, Pepper Pike, Shaker Heights and nearby — a mobile detailer works in your driveway while you keep your day. You skip the drop-off, the shuttle, and the waiting room, and the interior pricing above sits inside the typical Cleveland interior-detail range in this guide.
Want a firm number instead of a range? Call (216) 359-1034 or book online.
